component.name: Penguintier
component.summary: Unofficial tray app for ZeroTier networks

description.p: Penguintier puts your ZeroTier networks in the system tray, with the same menu as the official ZeroTier app on macOS and Windows.

ul.li: See your node address and copy it with one click
Toggle managed addresses, global IPs, default route and DNS per network
See each network's status, addresses and routes

description.p: It also makes ZeroTier's "Allow DNS Configuration" option work on Linux, by handing each network's DNS settings to systemd-resolved.
Penguintier is unofficial and not affiliated with ZeroTier, Inc. It needs the ZeroTier service (zerotier-one) to be installed.
